lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Lower flange to web, the lower bend of the Z step (about 89 deg). In the perpendicular sections at 25/50/75%, the label sits on the convex outer skin on the bisector ray: ray points lie at y = 0.00/-0.02/-0.03 mm (outer) and about 2.9 mm (inner skin, which matches t = 3.04). The nearest point is 0.10-0.12 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold, spans 36.3 mm against fold points at t = -0.5 to 36.8, and covers the full web width. The U-cutout tabs are coplanar with the lower flange, so they add no bend.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web to upper flange, the upper bend of the Z step (about 88 deg). In the 25/50/75% sections the label sits on the outer convex apex: bisector-ray points lie at y = -0.00/0.02/-0.01 mm, with the inner skin at about 2.9 mm. The nearest point is 0.04-0.07 mm away. The line is parallel and spans 35.9 mm against fold points at t = -0.9 to 36.6, so it covers the full fold width. The scatter near the upper-flange holes is hole-wall data, not a bend.
